name: SortListNode
label: Sort List
description: Sorts a list by one or more properties. Supports ascending or descending order.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ListToSort
fields.label: List to Sort
fields.description: The variable that holds the list to sort.

fields.name: SortByProperties
fields.label: Sort By Properties
fields.description: Enable if sorting based on object properties (e.g., files, folders).

fields.name: FirstProperty
fields.label: First Property to Sort By
fields.description: The first property name to sort the list by.

fields.name: FirstSort
fields.label: First Sort Direction
fields.description: Specifies whether to sort the first property in ascending or descending order.

fields.name: SecondProperty
fields.label: Second Property to Sort By
fields.description: The second property name to sort the list by.

fields.name: SecondSort
fields.label: Second Sort Direction
fields.description: Specifies whether to sort the second property in ascending or descending order.

fields.name: ThirdProperty
fields.label: Third Property to Sort By
fields.description: The third property name to sort the list by.

fields.name: ThirdSort
fields.label: Third Sort Direction
fields.description: Specifies whether to sort the third property in ascending or descending order.

fields.name: SortedList
fields.label: Sorted List
fields.description: The sorted version of the input list.
